purpose: Objectively validate tile-to-true-position distance as an additional solver metric against exact placement and clean/dirty/restored SSIM, without opening competition test, terminal, held, or fresh panels.
layout_convention: tile_at_position; every candidate is a strict permutation of 576 original upright tile identities

distance_metric_contract.position_error: For each tile identity t, invert candidate and exact tile_at_position layouts to predicted and true (row,column); compute errors in board cells.

absolute.median_manhattan_cells: numpy median over 576 integer Manhattan errors
absolute.within_radius_0_recall: fraction with Manhattan error <=0; exactly equal to exact tile recall

best_global_cyclic_aligned.candidate_family: all 576 whole-board numpy-style cyclic row/column rolls of the candidate layout
best_global_cyclic_aligned.tie_break: zero roll is initial incumbent; enumerate row roll 0..23 then column roll 0..23; replace only on strict decrease greater than 1e-12
best_global_cyclic_aligned.reported_metrics: the same complete metric suite evaluated after the selected single roll
best_global_cyclic_aligned.warning: aligned metrics are diagnostic only and must never replace absolute metrics because a globally mis-originated board can become perfect after alignment

deterministic_perturbation_roster.local_swaps32: horizontal swaps for rows [1,4,7,10,13,16,19,22] crossed with columns [2,8,14,20]
deterministic_perturbation_roster.block_swap_4x4: exchange equal row-major 4x4 regions rows2:6 cols2:6 and rows18:22 cols18:22
deterministic_perturbation_roster.component_shift_irregular21_plus10_plus1: move the connected 5x5-minus-four-corners component rooted at row3,col3 by (+10,+10); displaced destination identities fill corresponding vacated positions
deterministic_perturbation_roster.fixed_position_permutation: apply numpy.random.default_rng(20260831).permutation(576) to the positions of exact tile_at_position; identical position permutation on every source
deterministic_perturbation_roster.application: reference perturbations are target-assisted metric controls only; control perturbations are applied to frozen confirmed_six_arm_fusion

freeze_protocol.phase_1: materialize all 768 strict layouts, including reference-based diagnostic controls, and persist a candidate archive plus manifest
freeze_protocol.phase_2: write a pre-score freeze containing candidate hashes before computing any distance metric or SSIM
freeze_protocol.phase_3: only then compute metrics and correlations; no roster, perturbation, metric, or subgroup change is allowed

ssim_contract.layout_only_clean: recover clean tiles in shuffled input-identity order and assemble them under candidate layout; compare with clean organizer-train target
ssim_contract.production_like_dirty: assemble the original corrupted shuffled uint8 tiles under candidate layout; compare with clean organizer-train target
ssim_contract.production_like_restored: apply exactly one aiijc_puzzle.socket_pixel_tails.historical_rgb_luma_nlm_h20_once pass to dirty assembly; compare with clean organizer-train target

views.within_source_centered: Pearson after subtracting each source mean; Spearman after within-source average ranks, then pooling centered ranks
views.per_source: compute each correlation over 24 candidates within each source and report median, p25, p75 over 32 sources
views.family_mean: average every metric/SSIM over the 32 sources for each of 24 named layout variants, then correlate the 24 means

correlation_contract.quality_orientation: distance metrics are negated for headline quality-oriented correlations; radius recalls/exact are not negated

decision_questions: Does absolute mean Manhattan provide a smoother relationship with layout-only clean SSIM than exact radius0?
Does that relationship persist for dirty and restored production-like SSIM?
How much does best-global-cyclic alignment inflate correlation or hide absolute-origin errors?
Should distance replace exact, or be added only as a secondary diagnostic?
